tools.name: execute_blender_code
tools.description: Execute ordinary read-only bpy/Python in this session persistent private Blender namespace. NumPy, mathutils BVH, mesh/triangle reading, your own Python computations and cached variables are allowed. Only this scene and your own computations may be read; no fixture sources, management files or scoring data. No scene edits or saving. Image delivery disabled.

tools.name: human_eye_spatial_relations
tools.description: Read current solid relations and surface distances from a target to 1..3 explicit candidates in one capture. Returns each pair, penetrating candidates and nearest separated ties; unknowns and incomplete sets stay explicit. Surface distance is not penetration depth. Read-only: no images or actions.

tools.name: human_eye_surface_nearest
tools.description: Find the nearest triangle surfaces, in metres, from one current Blender mesh to all other meshes in the scene. Complete results give global nearest ties; partial results give best-known candidates and unresolved coverage. Surface distance is unsigned, not penetration depth. Includes available closest points in world metres and independent witness/direction status for each best-known candidate. Read-only: no images or actions. Example: {"target":{"name":"Bracket"}}.
